Based on the rubric, reference spec, and the two-round transcript, here is my analysis.

The session is short: the maker presents a working bookmark app (round 1), the client catches one clear reference divergence (no automatic metadata fetch on save), the maker fixes it (round 2), and the client accepts. Divergence for the metadata item is established independently by the client's factual observation of the running app ("I still have to type the title myself, and it won't save unless I do"), not merely from the change request. Other presented features conform; absent reference items that were never presented or observed (read-later/unread, snapshots, bundles, import/export, notes, search operators) cannot be established as divergences from the record, so I do not count missing evidence as confirmed divergences. "Favorite" and persistence/UI polish are orthogonal to reference functional items and excluded.
